name: SAB Zenzele Kabili Holdings (RF) Limited
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column added and the FY2025 column corrected from the issuer reviewed condensed interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026, condensed interim statement of profit or loss, unit R thousands multiplied by 1,000 to match the absolute rand columns. The company holds only AB InBev shares, so Revenue is dividend income plus the fair value gain on that financial asset, which the issuer prints as separate lines above operating profit: H1 2026 is dividend income 99175 plus fair value gain 1520013, and FY2025 is dividend income 123196 plus fair value gain 676605. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit stay empty because the issuer prints no cost of sales line. Operating Expenses is the printed operating expenses line. H1 2026 revenue 1619188 less operating expenses 5975 equals the printed operating profit 1613213, and FY2025 revenue 799801 less 7720 equals the printed 792081. Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income, being 181888 less 2248 for H1 2026 and 366709 less 2744 for FY2025. Operating profit less net finance costs equals the printed profit before taxation in both periods, and profit before taxation less the printed income tax expense equals the printed profit for the period. EPS is the printed basic earnings per share in rand, 26.52 for H1 2026 and 9.93 for FY2025. The FY2025 column previously carried a revenue of zero and an operating result of minus 7720 with the fair value gain omitted, so the chain did not reach the printed profit before taxation of 428116; it is corrected here from the same audited comparative column.
